source.title: 诊断学（第10版）
source.section: 第五篇 辅助检查 第一章 心电图 第七节

textbook_summary: Textbook describes flat or inverted T with ST depression and prominent U; overlap is permitted as an authored combination.

notes: Negate only the existing low-amplitude T electrode vector before projection. P/QRS/ST/U coefficients, support and optional U overlap remain unchanged. Resulting limb leads stay electrically consistent; aVR reverses oppositely.

limitations: Not a serum-potassium model or anatomical calibration
Net overlapping T-U voltage may cross baseline or become positive despite inverted intrinsic T
No new QT endpoint detector or automatic progression
Other low-K P/QRS/rhythm variants remain open
